newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman bourse index closes at record high.
newsitem.headline: Oman bourse index closes at record high.

text.p: The Oman stock exchange index climbed to its highest point since the bourse opened in 1989, hitting 288.21 points in the week to Wednesday in trade dominated by the banking and investment sectors.
The Muscat Securities Market said the stock exchange climbed by 7.36 percent to 288.21 points from 280.85 points the previous week.
The total value of trade was up at 24.1 million rials ($63.9 million) from 16.74 million rials the week earlier.
Turnover fell, with 7.6 million shares traded compared to 8.72 last week.
The exchange said said banking and investment sectors accounted for 70 percent of trade.

Dhofar International Development and Investment was among the most active stocks, with 923,000 shares worth 3.6 million rials changing hands. The stock gained, closing at 3.860 million rials from 3.420 rials.
Oman International Bank was also a leading player, with 865,000 shares worth 3.37 million rials traded. The stock closed at 4.000 rials, up from 3.780 rials.
Of the 76 shares traded in the week, 29 rose, 25 fell and 22 were unchanged.
